candidate_sentences.text: For the financial year ended June 30, 2025, SAF Tehnika Group’s performance improved substantially in profitability despite lower revenue.
Consolidated revenue decreased by 4% to EUR 25.99 million from EUR 27.09 million, while the parent company’s revenue declined by 6% to EUR 21.92 million.
The Group reported a net loss of EUR 643 thousand, compared with a loss of EUR 2.37 million in the prior year.
The parent company’s net loss decreased to EUR 552 thousand from EUR 1.34 million.

verified_key_information_units.information: Regional revenue changes: Americas region turnover decreased 14% to EUR 14.17 million (55% of group turnover), Europe region turnover increased 17% to EUR 10.0 million, Asia/TMiddle East/Africa region turnover decreased 5% to EUR 1.8 million.

candidate_sentences.text: The main pressure came from the Americas, where revenue fell by 14% to EUR 14.17 million, representing 55% of Group revenue.
European revenue increased by 17% to EUR 10.0 million, partly offsetting the decline, while revenue in Asia, Africa, and the Middle East decreased by 5% to EUR 1.8 million.

verified_key_information_units.information: Impact of geopolitical factors: Ongoing US-China trade tensions affect global electronics markets but currently have no significant negative impact on group sales; import duties remain unchanged for microwave equipment imported to the US from the EU, while Aranet products face a 15% duty; Canada branch established to mitigate supply chain and customs cost risks.
